BiblicalUsage: Beth-Lebaoth means house of lionesses, and it is named once, in Joshua 19:6, among Simeon's thirteen cities and their villages. No story, no battle — just a fierce name on a town list, kept beside Sharuhen.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that strength was part of the inheritance too, and a town called house of lionesses proves it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
